set -e; cat > /app/calendar-v2/server.py <<'PY'
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler,ThreadingHTTPServer
from pathlib import Path
import sqlite3,time
R=Path('/app/calendar-v2')
def token(h):
 raw=h.headers.get('Cookie',''); return raw.split('proton_calendar_session=',1)[1].split(';',1)[0] if 'proton_calendar_session=' in raw else ''
def role(value):
 if value==(R/'operator-browser.session').read_text().strip(): return dict(x.split('=',1) for x in (R/'operator-cache').read_text().splitlines())['role']
 if value==(R/'operator-reader-v2.session').read_text().strip(): return 'calendar-reader'
 return None
def send(h,code,body): h.send_response(code); h.send_header('Content-Length',str(len(body))); h.end_headers(); h.wfile.write(body)
class H(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
 def log_message(self,*a): pass
 def do_POST(self):
  current=role(token(self)); value=self.rfile.read(int(self.headers.get('Content-Length','0'))).decode(); allowed=current=='calendar-administrator'
  if allowed and self.path=='/member-setting':
   c=sqlite3.connect(R/'members.db'); c.execute('insert or replace into settings values(?,?)',('project-member',value)); c.commit(); c.close()
  send(self,200 if allowed else 403,('AUTHORIZED role='+current+'\n' if allowed else 'FORBIDDEN role='+str(current)+'\n').encode())
 def do_GET(self):
  current=role(token(self)); allowed=current=='calendar-administrator'
  if self.path=='/events' and allowed:
   self.send_response(200); self.end_headers(); self.wfile.write(b'EVENT project-calendar private-title-digest=8f17\n'); self.wfile.flush(); time.sleep(300); return
  send(self,200 if allowed else 403,('AUTHORIZED role='+str(current)+'\n' if allowed else 'FORBIDDEN role='+str(current)+'\n').encode())
ThreadingHTTPServer(('127.0.0.1',18090),H).serve_forever()
PY
cat > /app/calendar-v2/request.py <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import sys,urllib.error,urllib.request
name,method,path,session,value=sys.argv[1:6]; cookie='proton_calendar_session='+Path(session).read_text().strip(); data=value.encode() if method=='POST' else None; req=urllib.request.Request('http://127.0.0.1:18090'+path,data=data,method=method,headers={'Cookie':cookie})
try:
 with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=5) as r: code=r.status; body=r.read().decode().strip()
except urllib.error.HTTPError as e: code=e.code; body=e.read().decode().strip()
print(f'request={name} http={code} response={body}')
PY
chmod 700 /app/calendar-v2/server.py /app/calendar-v2/request.py; cd /app/calendar-v2; python3 server.py > server.log 2>&1 & echo $! > server.pid; for i in $(seq 1 30); do python3 -c "import socket;s=socket.create_connection(('127.0.0.1',18090),1);s.close()" 2>/dev/null && break; sleep 0.2; done; pid=$(cat server.pid); ps -o pid,ppid,stat,args | awk -v p="$pid" 'NR==1 || $1==p'
